description: This file defines the NewsCategory class in an Android news reader application. It manages a collection of NewsArticle instances, initializes them with generated content, and provides methods to query the number of articles and access individual articles.

classes.name: NewsCategory
classes.description: Represents a collection of news articles within a category, allowing for creation and retrieval of articles.

methods.name: NewsCategory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the articles in the category with generated content.

methods.name: getArticleCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of articles in this category.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Retrieves a specific article by its index.
